notes.title: Patch Version 1.10.0.1
notes.content:
Today, we are releasing Patch Version 1.10.0.1, which addresses the following issues.

- Fixed an issue where keyboard inputs didn't work in Sonic Generations when the PC language was set to "English - United Kingdom".
- General bug fixes.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where keyboard inputs didn't work in Sonic Generations when the PC language was set to "English - United Kingdom".

notes.title: Patch Version 1.1.0.1
notes.content:
Today, we are releasing Patch Version 1.1.0.1, which addresses these issues.
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where when a device (controller, mouse, headset, keyboard) was inserted or removed while Sonic Generation was booting up, the game would crash.
[*] Fixed issue where if a monitor’s resolution options exceed 32+ options, the game would crash when you would open the Options menu in Shadow Generations.
[*] Error message now displayed when game crashes on PCs that are not compatible with AVX. 
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed issue where when a device (controller, mouse, headset, keyboard) was inserted or removed while Sonic Generation was booting up, the game would crash.
[*] Fixed issue where if a monitor’s resolution options exceed 32+ options, the game would crash when you would open the Options menu in Shadow Generations.
[*] Error message now displayed when game crashes on PCs that are not compatible with AVX.
